programmes.d: A TV host profiles a local florist’s long-running flower competition in order to land her own show.
Hired to rebrand a radio show, Savannah finds herself falling in love after working with the host.
Tara marries Joe, a stranger as part of a TV show, but soon starts to fall for him after all.
A writer returns to her hometown for inspiration and reinkindles her romance with her first love.
When her dog is killed, Tara cancels her wedding. But her dog's ghost and her small town have a surprise.
Music exec Amanda clashes with brand rep Sam at a launch party, unaware she already met him online.
A chef bets she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city but ends up falling for the owner.
After sparks fly with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper.
A troubled teenage boy helps an aging wood carver finish an impossibly difficult job.
Nikki, a mechanic, falls for publicist Jeremy as they aim to make her the first female car show host.
A journalist covering the Don Juan of dating apps ends up finding there's more than meets the eye.
Jay's hazing ends abruptly after a Gamma Pi visit. Liz lies to cover for Mindy, causing big issues for others.
Sarah searches for her missing roommate. Jay endures Pete’s revenge as Kappa Psi sisters prep for Gamma Fair.
A watch that sets back time by five minutes, messes with Stephanie and Hunter’s budding romance.
A Scottish poet mistakes a writer’s identity, forcing her to choose between new love or the truth.
When a university student goes missing, her mother a former cop goes in search for her.
